prompt.zh-TW: 佩珊假設本益比 {{number:vars.pe|unit=times}}，乘上公司公告的預估每股盈餘，得到暖木家具的「合理價」，然後在課堂上說：「所以這支股票可以買。」針對佩珊的結論，哪一個說法最恰當？
prompt.en: Pei-shan assumes a P/E ratio of {{number:vars.pe|unit=times}} and multiplies it by the company’s published forecast earnings per share to get a ‘fair price’ for Warm Timber Furniture, then tells the class: ‘So this share is a buy.’ Which statement about her conclusion is the most appropriate?

text.zh-TW: 合理價取決於假設的倍數與預估盈餘，算出來不代表該買
text.en: A fair price depends on an assumed multiple and a forecast; it does not make the share a buy

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。合理價建立在兩個假設上，而且沒有考慮風險、資金與個人狀況；課堂練習到此為止。
feedback.en: That is right. A fair price rests on two assumptions and ignores risk, funding and personal circumstances; the classroom exercise stops here.

text.zh-TW: 算出合理價後，只要股價低於它，買進就一定划算
text.en: Once a fair price is calculated, buying at any price below it is bound to pay off

feedback.zh-TW: 你完成了估價的計算步驟，這部分沒問題。但「一定划算」把假設當成事實；預估盈餘可能落空，倍數也可能不合理。
feedback.en: You completed the valuation arithmetic, which is fine. But ‘bound to pay off’ treats assumptions as facts; the forecast may miss and the multiple may be inappropriate.

text.zh-TW: 把合理價算到更多位小數，佩珊的買進結論就比較站得住腳
text.en: Working the fair price out to more decimal places would make the case for buying somewhat sounder

feedback.zh-TW: 追求精確是好習慣。但這裡的不確定來自假設本身，不是小數位數；小數再多，假設錯了結果還是錯。
feedback.en: Precision is a good habit. But the uncertainty here comes from the assumptions, not the decimal places; more decimals cannot fix a wrong assumption.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_c7n3}}說清楚了本章的立場。{{option:o_d8p4}}把假設當成保證；{{option:o_e9q5}}誤把精確當成正確。本章是會計觀念練習，不是投資建議。
explanation.en: {{option:o_c7n3}} states this chapter’s position clearly. {{option:o_d8p4}} treats an assumption as a guarantee; {{option:o_e9q5}} mistakes precision for accuracy. This chapter is an accounting concept exercise, not investment advice.
